blocks.heading: Summer Digital Art Workshop
blocks.subheading: A 4-week online workshop covering character design, digital painting in Krita, and color theory. Perfect for beginners and intermediate artists.

items.title: Digital Painting Fundamentals
items.description: Master brush settings, layers, blending modes, and the Krita interface from scratch.

items.title: Color Theory in Practice
items.description: Learn to pick harmonious palettes, use value contrast, and create mood through color.

items.title: Character Design
items.description: Design original characters from concept sketches to fully colored illustrations.

children.text: Join Corinne for four weeks of hands-on digital art instruction. Each week includes a live session, a recorded lesson, and a creative assignment with personalized feedback.

Whether you've never opened Krita before or you've been drawing for years and want to level up, this workshop meets you where you are. All you need is a computer and a drawing tablet (recommendations provided).

blocks.heading: Ready to start your creative journey?
blocks.description: Limited spots available. Early bird pricing ends June 1st.
